notes: BUU v3.1.0 - Fieldwork cancellation scraper. New Fieldwork login type + a scrape step that reads a location's Service History and pulls every cancelled recurring service (frequency, reason, date, tech, amount) - one row per cancellation. Make a Fieldwork profile (email+password), navigate to the history URL with {{account_number}}/{{location_number}} tokens, add the Fieldwork scrape step. Output = two CSVs in results\ (cancellations deduped + a per-location log); input sheet untouched. First run: visible + step-by-step, log in at the first pause, check the first CSV, then Run all. Includes all of 3.0.5-3.0.7 (installers never delete your data, flows travel with the installer, update check fixed).
